card.name: Small linking words after 'observed' or 'associated'
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, an, with, according) right after a verb like 'observed', 'associated' or 'diagnosed', just before a patient group or a risk statement.

modes.label: 'in' after 'observed'
modes.description: The word 'in' after 'have been observed', leading into a patient group.
modes.example: and "cushingoid appearance" have been observed<< in>> patients receiving antiretroviral therapy

modes.label: 'an' after 'associated with'
modes.description: The word 'an' after 'associated with', leading into 'increased risk'.
modes.example: Fluoroquinolones have been associated with<< an>> increased risk of tendinitis and tendon

modes.label: 'with' before a condition
modes.description: The word 'with' after 'adults' or 'diagnosed', leading into a named condition.
modes.example: Women are diagnosed<< with>> CFS two to four times more often

card.plain: It fires on the small connecting word that comes before a patient group, a condition or an increased-risk statement.
